title: Suncor 千禧礦區
summary: 千禧礦區連接 Base Plant 的採礦、萃取與升級設備；本課研究一個環節延遲如何影響整條物流鏈。本課依序分析礦車與破碎站排隊、中間料緩衝、濕基與乾基回收、升級前熱量帳、串聯系統停機影響，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Millennium links mining with Base Plant extraction and upgrading; this case examines how delays propagate through the material chain. The course analyses queues between trucks and crusher, intermediate-feed buffering, wet-versus-dry-basis recovery, thermal account before upgrading, downtime in serial systems, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 礦車與破碎站排隊、中間料緩衝、濕基與乾基回收
v31FocusEn: Queues between trucks and crusher; Intermediate-feed buffering; Wet-versus-dry-basis recovery

quiz.question: 關於「礦車與破碎站排隊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Queues between trucks and crusher" is correct?
options: 每小時產能由車輛數、單車載重、有效作業比例與完整循環時間決定。
增加一倍車輛就一定增加一倍礦石供料量。
儲槽總容量就是隨時可用的產品庫存。
optionsEn: Hourly capacity depends on fleet count, payload, effective working fraction and complete cycle time.
Doubling the fleet necessarily doubles ore delivery.
Nominal tank capacity equals immediately usable product inventory.

steps.title: 礦車與破碎站排隊：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Queues between trucks and crusher: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「礦車與破碎站排隊」如何決定「Suncor 千禧礦區」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Queues between trucks and crusher” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Suncor Millennium mine”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「礦車與破碎站排隊」。千禧礦區連接 Base Plant 的採礦、萃取與升級設備；本課研究一個環節延遲如何影響整條物流鏈。在「Suncor 千禧礦區」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。每小時產能由車輛數、單車載重、有效作業比例與完整循環時間決定。循環必須包含排隊、裝載、行駛、卸載與回程；只用行駛時間會高估產能，且道路與破碎站瓶頸可能讓增加車輛反而增加等待。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Queues between trucks and crusher”. Millennium links mining with Base Plant extraction and upgrading; this case examines how delays propagate through the material chain. In the teaching model for Suncor Millennium mine, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Hourly capacity depends on fleet count, payload, effective working fraction and complete cycle time. Include queues, loading, travel, dumping and return. Using travel time alone overstates output, and road or crusher bottlenecks can turn additional trucks into additional waiting rather than production. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 礦車與破碎站排隊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Queues between trucks and crusher: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「礦車與破碎站排隊」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Queues between trucks and crusher” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = N payload availability 60/tcycle；代入 N = 8 trucks、payload = 225.5 tonne/trip、a = 0.8 fraction effective working time、t = 45 min/cycle，得 1,924 t/h（「礦車與破碎站排隊」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 t 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = N payload availability 60/tcycle; with N = 8 trucks, payload = 225.5 tonne/trip, a = 0.8 fraction effective working time, t = 45 min/cycle the result is 1,924 t/h (simplified exercise for Queues between trucks and crusher; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise t by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：t 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,749 t/h（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising t by 10% changes the result to 1,749 t/h (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1,924 t/h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 t 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1,924 t/h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in t with an engineering explanation.

物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。

Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For “Queues between trucks and crusher”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis.

steps.title: 礦車與破碎站排隊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Queues between trucks and crusher: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「礦車與破碎站排隊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Queues between trucks and crusher” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「礦車與破碎站排隊」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。以離散事件時間表重建一個班次，逐車核對載重與完成循環；比較平均公式與事件模擬的差額並解釋排隊影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Queues between trucks and crusher”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Reconstruct one shift with a discrete-event schedule, checking payload and completed cycles for each truck, then explain queue-related differences from the average formula. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 052-01 標記，圖表須寫明「Suncor 千禧礦區：教學假設」。提交循環事件表、裝卸站利用率及尖峰等待，分析限於調度模型，不涉及實車駕駛或採掘操作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 052-01 and mark charts “Suncor Millennium mine: teaching assumptions”. Submit cycle events, station utilization and peak waiting; keep the exercise within scheduling analysis rather than vehicle or excavation operation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「礦車與破碎站排隊」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Queues between trucks and crusher” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 礦車與破碎站排隊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Queues between trucks and crusher: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「礦車與破碎站排隊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 「中間料緩衝」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。把已預留給別種產品的槽容算入可用容量，會讓紙上緩衝時間過長；液位計偏差也可能使帳面與實際庫存無法閉合。
knowledge.textEn: An error at “Intermediate-feed buffering” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Counting tanks reserved for another grade inflates the apparent buffer; level-gauge bias can likewise prevent book inventory from closing against physical stock.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
